resume.body: You were on step {n} of {total} of the “{name}” guide.

welcome.title: Welcome to PrediGol
welcome.body: Shall we show you where everything is?

home.title: Home
home.body: Today, for you: your matches first, the day's picks —or why there are none— and your results.

matches.title: Matches
matches.body: All of the day's matches by league, with their forecast. From the Matches tab you reach Live and each match's analysis.

picks.title: Picks
picks.body: Only the picks PrediGol recommends, with their odds and the reason. Save them or add them to your parlay.

myPicks.title: My picks
myPicks.body: What you save is settled by the official result alone, and you see how you are doing.

more.title: More
more.body: More holds Parlays, Odds, your Profile and Help, where you can repeat this guide whenever you like.

panel.title: Guides
panel.intro: Short tours to get to know PrediGol. You can watch them again whenever you like.
panel.auto: Show the guide the first time I open a screen
panel.autoFailed: We could not save this setting. Please try again.

layers.title: Your matches first
layers.body: “For you” gathers your leagues and teams; “PrediGol” is the same for everyone. Your day starts here.

today.title: Today in your leagues
today.body: Tap a match to see its analysis: the forecast, the context and, when there is one, the pick with its real status.

results.title: Results
results.body: Here you see how recent matches and picks ended, always with the official result.

days.title: Pick the day
days.body: Move between Today, Tomorrow and other days, and filter by country, league or team.

list.title: By competition
list.body: Your leagues come first, then what is being played. Tap a match to see its analysis.

live.title: When it is played
live.body: These filters split what is being played now (Live), what is coming and what has finished.

filters.title: Filter what matters
filters.body: Pick a league and turn on “only with picks” to see the matches that have a pick first.

cards.title: It updates by itself
cards.body: It refreshes every 15 seconds. When matches are on, tap a card to open it.

header.title: The match
header.body: The time in your zone, the score and the star to follow the team.

tabs.title: The tabs
tabs.body: Start with Summary; then Analysis, Statistics, Markets, Line-ups, News and Post-match.

forecast.title: The forecast
forecast.body: Tap any term to see what it means. A forecast never guarantees a result.

list.title: Only what is recommended
list.body: A pick appears only when we measure an edge over the market price. If none qualifies, there are no picks today.

filters.title: Filters
filters.body: Filter by competition or by those already started today. On each pick you can save it or add it to your parlay.

official.title: PrediGol's parlays
official.body: The daily and the multi-day parlay only hold selections that pass every rule, and are never padded.

builder.title: Automatic builder
builder.body: Tell it what you want and PrediGol builds it with its rules, or says there is none worth making.

own.title: Build your own
own.body: Add selections from Picks, Odds or a match. Odds multiply: one selection failing is enough to lose it.

tabs.title: One market at a time
tabs.body: Switch between 1X2, goals, both teams to score and more. Each board shows the best odds for each selection.

fair.title: What are fair odds?
fair.body: They are the odds without the bookmaker's margin. They show whether the best odds pay more than they are worth.

above.title: Only above fair
above.body: Filters what pays more than the fair odds. Tap odds to add them to your parlay.

results.title: Your results
results.body: Today, 7 and 30 days, in units: PrediGol does not handle money. Only picks with odds count.

saved.title: Saved picks
saved.body: They settle by themselves with the official result. On each one you can note the odds you took.

parlays.title: Your parlays
parlays.body: The parlays you build stay here; they settle the same way, with the official result.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Here are your alias (how PrediGol greets you), your e-mail —which is not changed here— and your account's status.
account.tap: Tap a block to open it.

football.title: Your football, language and zone
football.body: The leagues, teams, players and markets you follow set what you see; they never change a pick, a probability or odds.
football.region: In Language and zone you choose Spanish or English and your time zone: every time is shown in your zone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Account, security, privacy and legal-change e-mails always arrive. Membership reminders, support replies and service notices are up to you.
notifications.digest: You can also ask for the weekly summary by e-mail.
notifications.device: And turn on notices on this device.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: What you accepted and when, usage statistics (off unless you turn them on), a copy of your data and how to make enquiries, claims or delete your account.

security.title: Security
security.body: Change your password, turn on two-step verification, close sessions you do not recognise and check your recent activity.

last.title: Membership and Help
last.membership: Your membership: its status, the days left and how to renew.
last.help: In Help: the frequent questions, “Report a problem”, your messages and the guides.
last.whatsapp: There is also a WhatsApp number to write to us.
